name: Cyclone Rush
description: The Ashmonk storms through the pit in a spinning rush that scatters everything in the way.

effects.text: Cyclone Rush tramples every foe in the storm.
The rush leaves embers on the skin.
The breathing cycle returns a little Chi.

runes.name: Tempest Cycle
runes.description: The rush spins wider and hits harder, but the breath takes longer to recover.

runes.name: Cinder Trail
runes.description: The rush leaves burning cinders that keep eating at the wounded.

runes.name: Serpent Coil
runes.description: A tight, quick rush that coils back to the centre instead of racing wide.

name: Palm Burst
description: A focused palm strike that shoves every nearby enemy back off its feet.

effects.text: Palm Burst strikes all foes in range.
The shove knocks enemies off balance.

runes.name: Quake Palm
runes.description: A ground-shaking strike that rattles a wider circle of enemies.

runes.name: Empty Hand
runes.description: A drained, light strike that costs almost no Chi.

name: Chi Surge
description: The Ashmonk draws a deep breath and floods the body with rushing Chi.

effects.text: Half of the Chi pool is restored at once.

runes.name: Rushing Breath
runes.description: A quicker, lighter breath that restores Chi more often.

runes.name: Still Point
runes.description: A long, perfect breath whose stillness outlasts the rush.

name: Serpent Strike
description: Two fast fangs of a strike that open a bleeding wound in the target.

effects.text: The first fang strikes the target.
The second fang leaves a bleeding wound.

runes.name: Venom Fang
runes.description: The second fang is coated in venom instead of plain steel.

runes.name: Flurry of Fangs
runes.description: A faster flurry of strikes that chews through a single foe.

name: Stillness
description: Perfect stillness knits the body back together and hardens it against the next blow.

effects.text: Stillness restores a fifth of the body's health.
A skin of hardened Chi absorbs blows.

runes.name: Perfect Zen
runes.description: A deeper stillness that mends far more, but takes long to find again.

runes.name: Stone Body
runes.description: The stillness hardens into rock, trading mending for a tougher shell.
